description: Find every operation written with digits and an "=" or "≈" in a text — an email, a report, an invoice, your own draft or another model's answer — and recalculate it: correct, rounded, or WRONG with what it should say, each with its line. Understands × · x ÷ :, powers, roots, real-life percentages ("200 + 21 % = 242", "15 % of 200 = 30"), currency signs, thousands separators and decimal comma or point (detected). Use it before trusting or sending a text with numbers in it: a model gets arithmetic wrong with the same confidence as when it is right. Sentences in words are not read, and it says so.

decimal.description: Decimal separator; auto detects it from the numbers (1.234,56 vs 1,234.56)

path.description: Path to a text or Markdown file. Alternative to text

name: arithmetic_check
title: Recalculate every "=" operation written in a text
